name: How to Use git clone (Step-by-Step)
description:
In this video, you will learn what the git clone command is used for and how to use it. I show step by step how git clone works to download a project from GitHub to your computer.

👨‍💻 If you’re new to working with Git, this video will be useful for you!
🔧 A helpful guide for those who want to learn how to use GitHub, Git, Terminal, and the CLI.

📌 If you want to see more videos about Git commands, don’t forget to subscribe!

name: How to add new repository (Step-by-Step)
description:
🔧 In this video, you will learn step by step how to create a new repository on GitHub and how to connect it to your computer.

📌 Topics covered:

Creating a new repository

Connecting via Terminal

Using Git commands

💡 Perfect for beginners!

📥 If you have any questions, feel free to leave a comment below!

name: How to delete repository
description:
In this video, I show step by step how to delete a repository from your GitHub account. If you want to remove a project that is unnecessary or was created for testing purposes, this video will help you.

📌 Guide:

Log in to your GitHub account
Select the repository you want to delete
Open the Settings section

Confirm the deletion of the repository
📢 If you have any questions, you can leave them in the comments!

name: Introduction to Dart Programming
description:
🎯 What is Dart?
In this short 3-minute video, we give you the basic information about the Dart language:
🔹 Why was Dart created?
🔹 What kind of programming is it used for?
🔹 How does it work with Flutter?

If you want to start mobile or web development, it’s important to get familiar with this language!n👇 Don’t forget to subscribe to the channel and hit “like”!

name: Dart Programming | Lesson 1
description:
In this video, we introduce the Dart programming language.
In the first lesson, we learn the following concepts:
✔️ int – whole numbers
✔️ double – decimal numbers
✔️ String – text data
✔️ var – automatically typed variables

If you want to learn Dart from scratch, this video is perfect for you!n👇 Don’t forget to subscribe to the channel for the next lessons!

name: Upload project to Upwork
description:
🎯 How to add a portfolio project to Upwork?
In this video, I show step by step how to upload a project to your Upwork account. I also briefly explain what Upwork is and why it’s useful.
A great starting point for anyone who wants to work as a freelancer! 🚀

🔗 If you found it helpful, don’t forget to subscribe and hit the like button.

name: Dart Programming | Lesson 2
description:
💻 Dart Programming Language Lesson: String, int, double, var, and Using Comments

In this video lesson, we learn the basic data types in Dart:
✅ String: For text data
✅ int: For whole numbers
✅ double: For decimal numbers
✅ var: Automatically determines the type
✅ // : Used for writing comments

By the end of the lesson, you will be able to:
🔹 Perform mathematical operations
🔹 Combine (concatenate) strings
🔹 Explain your code using comments

🌟 Perfect for beginners learning Dart!

👉 Don’t forget to subscribe and leave a “like”!

name: Dart Programming | Lesson 4
description:
This video is about Null Safety, one of the most important features of the Dart language.
What is null? Why is Null Safety important? How are the !, ?, ??, and ??= operators used?
I explain everything with simple examples.
